name: complex_questions
description: Moments that need synthesis, not just retrieval: advice requests, vendor comparisons, hypotheticals. Exercises the grounded LLM escalation lane.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Thanks for making time today. Before we dive in, anything top of mind?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: How would you handle integration with our warehouse, and what about data residency?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Good question. Our connector supports Postgres and Snowflake out of the box.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Okay. And what should I tell procurement when they ask about you versus RivalHQ?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: We automate the reporting they export manually.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Sure, but what if our security team flags risk in your standard terms next month?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Legal has standard fallback language for that.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Fine. What does the enterprise tier cost per seat?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Enterprise is quoted per seat with volume tiers.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Great, let's schedule a follow up call next week.
